name: Zetsuboushi
source:
Renji has a special power, which has been handed down from his ancestors. To get away from his fate, he asks Aoi, his childhood friend, for help. Actually, Renji and Aoi promised to marry when they were kids. But it is just the beginning of his despair.... Renji is betrayed by Aoi.... He decides to accept his fate to win her heart...!

[From ErogeShop]
